title: Price Roll Disturbance
event: In the central Kaufhaus atrium the creature sits centered beneath the store's hanging signage. A tentacle flicks a suspended, automatic pricing dispenser on a promotional podium; it whirs and vomits a continuous adhesive price-tape that unspools across the polished floor, snagging on an escalator step and yanking a row of ceiling catalog placards loose. The placards slide down the escalator like sleds, scattering brochures.
monsterPresence: Head and upper body visible, face intent; multiple tentacles actively manipulate the dispenser and press against the escalator rail.
consequence: A long sticky price-tape snakes from the podium, stuck over an escalator step and trailing into aisle space; several catalog placards lie torn on the escalator.
nextHook: sticky price tape across central escalator
stillPrompt: Kaufhaus atrium: central plant-like monster with humanoid face unspooling a sticky price-tape that snakes over an escalator step; torn catalog placards scattered on steps; warm store lighting and recognizable store signage in the background.
videoPrompt: 5s: Close-to-midshot of the monster at a promotional podium in a Kaufhaus atrium. Tentacle engages an automatic pricing dispenser. Tape unspools, slaps onto an escalator step, pulls down hanging catalog placards which slide and scatter. Keep the store's escalator, ceiling signage, and display counters visible. Sound: motor whirr, soft tearing.
cameraCue: After the tape snaps onto the escalator, camera tilts down and pushes forward to fully reveal the sticky tape trail and catalog placards on the steps, briefly concealing the monster behind the podium rim before revealing the trailing tape.

title: Neukölln Panel Exposed
event: The sticky price-tape drags across a promotional borough map wall near the escalator. As a tentacle tightens the tape, it rips whole printed layers off the map; a hidden leaflet panel swings open revealing a neon-laminated insert that reads 'Neukölln' and a band of locality photos. A security sensor pops red and a small alarm strobe blinks above the map.
monsterPresence: Mostly tentacles in frame pulling the tape; the creature's eyes and lower face appear at the map edge, studying the exposed panel.
consequence: A partially torn borough map panel hangs ajar with a neon 'Neukölln' insert visible and a blinking red alarm/strobe above it.
stillPrompt: Interior near Kaufhaus escalator: torn promotional map panel hanging open to reveal a neon 'Neukölln' insert and locality photos; a tentacle pulls tape across it; a small red alarm strobe blinks overhead. Visible store fixtures and shelving frame the composition.
videoPrompt: 2s: Midshot on the promotional map wall adjacent to escalator. Tentacle yanks sticky tape across the map, peeling printed layers; panel flips open to show neon 'Neukölln' insert; red alarm strobe blinks. Keep shot tight on map so store background hints Kaufhaus identity.
cameraCue: After the panel flips, camera quickly dollies in and tilts to frame the exposed 'Neukölln' insert and the blinking alarm, partially concealing the creature behind the map frame to emphasize the discovered panel.

title: Depth Collapse
event: A nearby endcap labeled 'Kaufhaus Sortiment' (a deep vertical stack of identical canned goods) becomes the target: the monster hooks two tentacles under the bottom shelf and drags; the stacked cans wobble, then topple in a controlled vertical domino, rolling down an aisle and slamming into a low platform to form an arched bridge of cans spanning the walkway, revealing a dark service shaft lid hidden beneath the display.
monsterPresence: Hands and shoulders visible; face leans forward watching the cascade, expression focused and pleased.
consequence: A neat arched bridge of linked cans spans the aisle, with the service shaft lid now exposed where the display used to stand.
stillPrompt: Kaufhaus aisle: arching bridge of canned goods formed from a toppled endcap; the service shaft lid is exposed beneath the former display. The plant-like monster leans over the bridge with tentacles still touching the cans.
videoPrompt: 3s: Wide-to-midshot down an aisle. Monster pulls at a stacked endcap; cans topple and roll, colliding to form an arched bridge across the walkway while a service shaft lid is revealed where the display collapsed. Ambient store sounds and the clatter of cans.
cameraCue: After the last can locks into the arch, the camera cranes back and shifts to a low wide to reveal the full can-bridge and the exposed shaft, momentarily concealing the monster behind the arch before revealing its upper body watching the structure.

title: Reuterkiez Steam
event: On the arched can-bridge the monster opens small jars pulled from the collapsed endcap and sprinkles spices; the spice dust hits tiny embedded LED labels and reacts—bursting into short-lived colored steam puffs that rise and paint ephemeral silhouettes of playground slides and rowhouse rooftops onto the atrium skylight. The scented steam drifts across a nearby clothing mannequin display, making a scarf billow as if a breeze from the neighborhood has blown through.
monsterPresence: Face is visible, inhaling; tentacles scatter spices across the can-bridge. The creature's expression shifts to a mischievous smile as steam forms.
consequence: Faint, colored steam graffiti—silhouettes of local Reuterkiez features—clings to the atrium skylight glass; a scarf on a mannequin flutters from the scented draft.
nextHook: colored steam graffiti on glass skylight
stillPrompt: Kaufhaus atrium under skylight: colored, ephemeral steam silhouettes of slides and rowhouse roofs on the glass; a mannequin scarf billows; the creature's face watches from the can-bridge below, tentacles dusted with spice.
videoPrompt: 2s: Mid-to-high shot from the can-bridge up toward the skylight. Monster sprinkles spice; colored puffs form and drift, leaving temporary silhouettes on the glass; the mannequin scarf flutters. Emphasize store skylight and interior architecture so location reads as Kaufhaus.
cameraCue: After colored puffs hit the skylight, camera cranes upward and holds on the glass graffiti, concealing the monster behind the bright skylight until the next beat.

title: Product Chain Unravel
event: The steam condenses into droplets that fall onto a nearby wide assortment table; when droplets strike product labels they briefly electrify, and the monster's tentacles guide a chaotic wave: varied items (books, scarves, tins, toys) levitate a few inches and latch together magnetically, forming a snaking product-chain banner. The chain slithers across the floor toward the storefront window, labels aligning into a stitched strip that reads 'Sortimentsbreite' in mismatched type.
monsterPresence: Mostly tentacles actively shaping and holding items; the creature's face is off-center, half-occluded by a hanging lamp, watching the chain form.
consequence: A long snaking product-chain banner composed of diverse store items extends from the assortment table and heads toward the storefront window, reading 'Sortimentsbreite' in patched labels.
nextHook: product-chain banner extending into storefront window
stillPrompt: Kaufhaus interior near storefront: a long product-chain banner formed of books, tins, scarves and toys snakes toward the window bearing a patched 'Sortimentsbreite' label; tentacles adjust links; store window and street beyond are visible.
videoPrompt: 5s: Wide shot tracking the product-chain as it forms on an assortment table and slithers toward the Kaufhaus storefront window. Items levitate briefly, snap together magnetically, forming a stitched banner reading 'Sortimentsbreite'. Keep store architecture and window display visible.
cameraCue: After the banner completes, camera pushes through the storefront glass to follow the chain into the window, briefly concealing the monster behind the glass reflection as the banner strikes the outside sidewalk.

title: Kreuzkölln Pull
event: The product-chain reaches the storefront glass and a street performer on the sidewalk (a Kreuzkölln-style busker visible through the window) grabs the banner's end and gives it a theatrical pull. The stitched labels snap into new positions as the performer tugs, rearranging into a stencil-like graffiti that spells 'Kreuzkölln' on the pavement; a flurry of lightweight price tags flutters out through the open doorway and into the street like confetti.
monsterPresence: The creature's face appears as a reflected overlay in the storefront glass—eyes wide, mouth a small O—partially occluded; a single tentacle rests on the inside of the glass as if feeling the pull.
consequence: Stencil-style graffiti on the sidewalk spells 'Kreuzkölln'; the storefront door is ajar with scattered price-tag confetti trailing outside and the monster's reflection marked on the glass.
stillPrompt: Exterior view through Kaufhaus storefront: stencil-like 'Kreuzkölln' graffiti appears on the sidewalk as a busker pulls a banner through the open door; confetti price-tags trail out; the monster's face is reflected in the window overlapping the graffiti.
videoPrompt: 2s: Exterior-to-interior shot. Busker grabs the product-chain banner through the open storefront and pulls; labels snap into 'Kreuzkölln' on the pavement; price-tag confetti drifts outside; the creature's face is reflected in the glass. End on the layered reflection of monster and graffiti.
cameraCue: After the banner snaps into place on the pavement, camera stays outside and frames the storefront so the monster's reflected face overlays the freshly formed 'Kreuzkölln' graffiti, revealing consequence while concealing the creature behind reflection.
